description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Zameck Guildmage.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Zameck Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 4.
